Class Charge

java.lang.Object
Actor
Charge
All Implemented Interfaces:
HasEField
public class Charge extends Actor implements HasEField
An actor representing a point charge, which produces an electric field radially outward for positive charges and inward for negative charges. The strength of the electric field at a given point can be found using Coulomb's law. Charges can be fixed or movable, and the player mainly controls the motion of the puck by placing charges.

    • getZIndex

      public int getZIndex()
      Description copied from class: Actor
      Gets the z-index, or depth value, of the actor, which determines whether it should drawn on top of or below other actors. Actors will be drawn in order by increasing z-index, so actors with higher z-indices will appear on top. This method should be overriden by child classes to return the z-index that corresponds to the specific type of actor.

      List of actors by their z-index:

      • 10: UniformEField
      • 11: UniformBField
      • 20: TotalEField
      • 21: TotalBField
      • 100: Switch
      • 110: Wire
      • 200: Goal
      • 210: Wall
      • 300: ChargeBag
      • 310: Charge (fixed)
      • 311: Charge (non-fixed)
      • 400: Puck
      Overrides:
      getZIndex in class Actor
      Returns:
      The z-index of the actor
